items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I guess I look too much like and Arab or something to her

ctx.x: What was your experience when that happened? Were you aware as it was happening, did you hear things?

Yeah, well you could smell it. I could smell it. I saw on television what was happening. But then, that night, I went in a bar on the corner there. It was a bar where I had been having lunch or dinner quite often and I had been going in there all the time; it’s right on 8th avenue. I went in and the barmaids just kept looking at me and passing me by, and never coming. I just looked at them and they kept on serving. Finally, she came down and she said, “Can I help you?” I told her, “I’d like a beer.” She says,…
never came. I haven’t been in there since. Anybody that doesn’t want my money, I don’t force it on them.
